description: This file defines the A2UIHandler class responsible for managing interactions with a web-based User Interface (UI) within an Android application. It includes methods for URL resolution, readiness checking, message decoding, and applying messages to the UI component, along with some JavaScript snippets for client-side operations.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing interactions between the app and an OpenClaw A2UI web UI, including URL resolution, readiness checks, and message decoding/application.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks whether a given URL is a trusted action URL for the canvas.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the A2UI host URL based on node and operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Suspends until the A2UI is ready or times out after multiple attempts.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes JSON message payloads sent to the A2UI, validating and converting them as needed.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates incoming message JSON objects against the expected schema for version 0.8.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to apply messages to the A2UI.
